# CASE STUDY 1: Haga Physical Verification Layer
- Slug: haga_case_study
- Type: Personal / Startup
- Client / Company: Haga Labs
- Author: Mushood Hanif
- Role: Founder & AI Systems Architect

Executive Summary: Independent trust, benchmarking, and physics-consistency verification layer for robot policies and generative world models.
Metrics:
- 98.4% Physics Perturbation Pass Rate
- 0% Data Drift Between Public & Dataroom
- 85% Manual Review Time Saved
